preamble.summary: 1 Samuel 26 narrates David's second sparing of Saul (parallel to chapter 24, often regarded as a doublet). 4QSamᵃ preserves fragments. The doublet question is not resolved by the DSS — both narratives are present in the same scroll, just as in MT.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant variants. The DSS preserves both sparing narratives without merging or omitting either.
